failure: Failure: Support recovery does not identify product complexes or separate channels with identical reactant and product complexes. It excludes null reactions; exact controlled resets and complete state observation are essential. The attached note provides no supporting code or run receipts, and does not establish realistic cell-scale acquisition.
interface: Interface: d labeled species; known bounded input order k, rate floor kappa_min, rate ceiling, and controlled exact molecule-count resets; complete labeled destructive endpoint states and calibrated short observation times. Duplicate reactions sharing a reactant support are aggregated at this stage. Randomized finite-sample recovery additionally assumes independent runs, known rate/resource bounds, and no hidden species or readout noise.

claims.title: Positive departure hazards expose sparse reactant supports under exact reset and endpoint access
